Name: Asters Royalcore Custom Picture Frames
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Content pack for Custom Picture Frames that adds several royalcore themed picture frames which you can fill with screenshots in-game
Description:
_Description:_

*   Content pack for Custom Picture Frames

*   Adds several royalcore themed picture frames

*   Take pictures in-game and display them on your walls!

*   If you like this you could buy me a [coffee](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)﻿ to show your support
_To start:_

1.  Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿)

2.  Launch the game

3.  Buy picture frames at Robin's Carpenter shop

4.  Press f10 to start taking a picture to put in your frame, press f11 to switch between different frames, press f12 to take a picture (might need to also press fn depending on your computer. It's also possible to change the hot keys in the Custom Picture Frames config file)

5.  Put the frame on your wall and hover over it and press f11 until you find the picture you want
_Tips and tricks_

*   The CustomPictureFrames mod save your images whether you save the day or not

*   Since each save file has it's own album in the "CustomPictureFrames" folder you can try making your own art and putting it in the folder. This is how I managed to get higher resolution art in my screenshots, if you use the game's internal screenshot feature make sure to set the zoom level of the screenshot to 100% or it'll get pixelated. This trick won't work with the frame that hangs on the beam though, and this is not a bug cause the framework wasn't intended to be used this way anyway.
